      ECPT(16) = 0

      ECPT(18) = 0
      NECPT(19) = 0
      ECPT(20) = 0
      ECPT(21) = 0
      ECPT(22) = 1

      SUBROUTINE SMA1B (KIJ, IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE, FACTOR)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KIJ(6,6), FACTOR
      INTEGER IGRID, ICODE, IFFILE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(3,3,4,4)
      INTEGER NBLOCKS
      COMMON /CAPTURE/ KSTORE, NBLOCKS
      REAL ECPT(100)
      INTEGER NECPT(100)
      EQUIVALENCE (NECPT(1), ECPT(1))
      COMMON /SMA1ET/ ECPT
      INTEGER IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, ISKP(17)
      LOGICAL NOGOO
      COMMON /SMA1CL/ IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, ISKP, NOGOO
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IGRP
      IF (FACTOR .NE. 0.0D0) RETURN
      DO 10 IPVT = 1, 4
        IF (NPVT .EQ. NECPT(IPVT+2)) GO TO 20
   10 CONTINUE
      RETURN
   20 DO 30 IGRP = 1, 4
        IF (IGRID .EQ. NECPT(IGRP+2)) GO TO 40
   30 CONTINUE
      RETURN
   40 DO 50 I = 1, 3
        DO 50 J = 1, 3
          KSTORE(I, J, IPVT, IGRP) = KIJ(I, J)
   50 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE GET_KMATRIX (KFULL)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KFULL(12,12)
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(3,3,4,4)
      INTEGER NBLOCKS
      COMMON /CAPTURE/ KSTORE, NBLOCKS
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IGRP, IROW, ICOL
      DO 100 IPVT = 1, 4
        DO 90 IGRP = 1, 4
          DO 80 I = 1, 3
            DO 80 J = 1, 3
              IROW = (IPVT-1)*3 + I
              ICOL = (IGRP-1)*3 + J
              KFULL(IROW, ICOL) = KSTORE(I, J, IPVT, IGRP)
   80         CONTINUE
   90       CONTINUE
  100 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE TRANSD (ICSID, T)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICSID
      DOUBLE PRECISION T(9)
      T(1)=1.0D0; T(2)=0.0D0; T(3)=0.0D0
      T(4)=0.0D0; T(5)=1.0D0; T(6)=0.0D0
      T(7)=0.0D0; T(8)=0.0D0; T(9)=1.0D0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE MESAGE (ICODE, IMSG, IPARM)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICODE, IMSG, IPARM(2)
      INTEGER OUT, SYSBUF
      LOGICAL NOGO
      COMMON /SYSTEM/ SYSBUF, OUT, NOGO
      WRITE(OUT,900) ICODE, IMSG
  900 FORMAT(' MESAGE code=',I6,' msg=',I6)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE WRITE (IFILE, BUF, NWORDS, IFLG)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER IFILE, NWORDS, IFLG
      REAL BUF(1)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE HMAT (NECPT)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER NECPT(4)
      REAL MATBUF(7)
      COMMON /HMTOUT/ MATBUF
      MATBUF(1) = 50.0
      RETURN
      END
